title: The extensible no-four-on-a-circle problem
summary: We show that there exists a set $S \subset \mathbb{Z}^2$ containing no four points on a circle or a line such that $|S \cap [n]^2| = Ω(n)$ as $n \rightarrow \infty$. Since any no-four-on-a-circle set in $[n]^2$ has size $O(n)$, this resolves (up to a constant) a question raised by the current authors and Keevash concerning the density of extensible no-four-on-a-circle constructions. Our construction is based on weighted random sampling from the integer lattice followed by careful deletion.
